requirements.quote:
If the zone does not contain any RRsets that exactly match <SNAME,
   SCLASS> but does contain an RRset that matches <SNAME, SCLASS, STYPE>
   via wildcard name expansion, the name server MUST include the



Arends, et al.              Standards Track                    [Page 12]


RFC 4035             DNSSEC Protocol Modifications            March 2005


   wildcard-expanded answer and the corresponding wildcard-expanded
   RRSIG RRs in the Answer section and MUST include in the Authority
   section an NSEC RR and associated RRSIG RR(s) proving that the zone
   does not contain a closer match for <SNAME, SCLASS>.
requirements.condition: The zone contains no RRsets that exactly match <SNAME, SCLASS>, but contains an RRset matching <SNAME, SCLASS, STYPE> through wildcard name expansion.
requirements.required_behavior: The name server MUST include the wildcard-expanded answer in the Answer section.
requirements.why_checkable: A wildcard-answer response can be inspected for the expanded answer and its placement in the Answer section.

   via wildcard name expansion, the name server MUST include the



Arends, et al.              Standards Track                    [Page 12]

   RRSIG RRs in the Answer section and MUST include in the Authority

requirements.quote:
If the zone does not contain any RRsets that exactly match <SNAME,
   SCLASS> but does contain an RRset that matches <SNAME, SCLASS, STYPE>
   via wildcard name expansion, the name server MUST include the



Arends, et al.              Standards Track                    [Page 12]


RFC 4035             DNSSEC Protocol Modifications            March 2005


   wildcard-expanded answer and the corresponding wildcard-expanded
   RRSIG RRs in the Answer section and MUST include in the Authority
   section an NSEC RR and associated RRSIG RR(s) proving that the zone
   does not contain a closer match for <SNAME, SCLASS>.  If space does
   not permit inclusion of the answer, NSEC and RRSIG RRs, the name
   server MUST set the TC bit (see Section 3.1.1).
requirements.condition: The zone contains no RRsets that exactly match <SNAME, SCLASS>, but contains an RRset matching <SNAME, SCLASS, STYPE> through wildcard name expansion. Space does not permit inclusion of the answer, NSEC and RRSIG RRs.
requirements.required_behavior: The name server MUST set the TC bit.
requirements.why_checkable: A size-constrained wildcard-answer response can be inspected to verify that its TC bit is set.
